title: Old /sites links forward permanently, and a missing podcast Show is noindex
detail:
SEO/GEO meta scan 2026-11-18. (1) /sites/<slug> and /sites/<slug>/<page> were retired by the owner on 2026-10-06 and forward to /spaces/<slug>, but with redirect() (a temporary 307), so any /sites URL a search engine already held kept its own index entry and did not pass its signals on. Both now use permanentRedirect() (308). (2) A podcast Show page whose Space exists but whose show does not returned { title: 'Show not found' } with no robots, inheriting the root index,follow; it now carries noindex,nofollow like the missing-Space branch beside it.

Same scan, checked and sound: check:seo green (35 marketing pages, 44 sitemap routes, 431 titles); root metadataBase, title template, no inherited root canonical; every public page has its own title, description, canonical and openGraph; help pages set twitter through helpPageMetadata; sitemap excludes noindex pages; robots allows the AI crawlers on public content and disallows only private or token paths; /how, /facilities and /lab are LINK_ONLY_ROBOTS (live /how serves noindex,nofollow,noarchive), out of sitemap, nav and llms.txt; JsonLd escapes <; Event, LocalBusiness, Organization, WebSite and breadcrumb nodes complete; llms.txt and llms-full.txt serve text/plain with live counts and real routes; www redirects 308 to the apex on production. Watch: lib/marketing/quick-answers.ts hardcodes /discover/cities/encinitas, /carlsbad and /oceanside, and a city page 404s when its town has nothing listed; all three resolve today (they appear in the generated Cities section of the live llms.txt).

verify.note: Fails on main: both /sites routes use redirect() and the missing-show head has no robots. Passes when both forward with permanentRedirect and the head is noindex.
